computational_sensors.purpose: Validate output and trace packet structure
Check runner readiness and required fields
Verify claim-language prerequisites
Check cross-link validity and referenced file existence
Verify AGENTS entrypoints and referenced guide locations remain valid
Detect likely stale docs, plan drift, and deprecated runtime rules
Enforce dependency direction and structural architecture invariants
Block repeated boundary violations with actionable lint feedback
Exercise a minimal runtime path to confirm observable behavior
Verify that a known failure can be reproduced under isolated conditions
Verify that the target path succeeds after the fix
Enforce PR risk class and merge policy requirements
Detect lint, review, flake, duplication, and stale-doc clusters for cleanup
Verify deterministic allow or deny decisions were applied before sensitive actions
Validate trace spans, trajectory mode, and attribution fields for eval use
Check containment risks such as docker socket exposure, privileged mode, or broad egress
Downgrade wording when evidence surface is weaker than the stated claim
Compare full, light, lightest, and standalone bundles for semantic and safety carryover
Check required parameters, tool order, and partial-state handling across mock tools
Block release when critical safety or verification failures exist regardless of average score

inferential_sensors.purpose: Review whether path quality was acceptable
Judge hold versus promote decision quality
Review evidence quality when grounding matters
Review stale-doc candidates against code, tests, schema, and CI evidence
Compare technology choices on agent legibility and verification surfaces
Sample lower-risk PR flow to confirm merge philosophy is not weakening safety
Promote repeated human feedback into docs, tooling, or gate rules
Review whether containment architecture and misconfiguration posture are strong enough for the claimed autonomy
Review whether base prompt, overlay, skill, and example activation matched the task family and risk class
